##### Additional Information
The memory requirements of the new `dbengine` mode are too high. This PR drops them to about half.

issue_context.title: Optimize the memory footprint of the Database Engine
issue_context.body:
Optimize the memory footprint of the Database Engine of #5303.
6% of the uncompressed data is high and should be improved.

review_comments: Why not `rrdeng_get_statistics()` and just use proper definitions for the indexes below? (last entry could be RRD_ENG_STATISTICS_MAX or something)
I want it to break whenever somebody decides to add a new statistic cause the risk is great.
how about callocz() and ditch the rest of the lines of manual assignment?
magic numbers, unless this is indeed some counter
That's no magic number nor a counter. It's a complex state word described in `pagecache.h`.
